name: Tantei Joshu Gallium no Rojiura Tankenki
original_name: 探偵助手ガリウムのろじうら探検記
source:
This is an anthropomorphic game!
The main character is Gallium, the 31st element, who cannot be touched by people because of his constitution (nature) and lives a peaceful(?) life as an aluminum detective assistant, despite his frustration. The main character is Gallium, the 31st element, who is unable to touch people due to his constitution and lives a peaceful(?) life as a detective assistant of Aluminum.

There are about 9 elements in the game.

[From [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11683?lang=EN]Novel Game Collection[/url]]
translation:
这是一个拟人化的游戏！
主角是第31种元素镓，由于体质（本性）而不能被人接触，尽管内心沮丧，但作为铝侦探助理过着平静的（？）生活。主角是第31号元素镓，由于体质原因无法与人接触，作为铝公司的侦探助手过着平静（？）的生活。

游戏中有大约9个元素。

[来自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/11683?lang=EN]小说游戏合集[/url]]
